_: Phase 8 (communications): every Modbus row with no value at 150 MW (turbine src/data/tcs-dcs.json modbus, package src/ui/plant/modbus.js fa / esp / ctcs), with its reason. type b = correct with no value (evidence), c = NO-SOURCE after every doc was read (docs named), m = the link works, the value needs the plant model (owner Phase 11), open = work left (owner). tests/lanes/qa/phase8-gate.cjs: row 8 may be TAPOS only when the live no-value rows equal these rows and none is open.
